items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Unfortunately, I don't know too much about Thelonius Monk, except I've read a little something about him, and I've never seen him play.

ctx.x: Yeah. What about somebody like Thelonius Monk, whose style was just somewhere else, compared to what had been going on in piano playing? How did you feel about that?

Unfortunately, I don't know too much about Thelonius Monk, except I've read a little something about him, and I've never seen him play. I've heard one or two of his recordings, but they were interesting, and I've heard musicians that play in my group talk about him. And they respected him, you know, and they said, he knows what he's doing, you know. I would love to have met him, you know, because he created something there, Thelonius Monk.
